out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed cases of beverages stored directly on the floor next to WIC.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PIC moved cases of beverages to approved shelving units.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. PIC was not able to provide Certified Food Manager certification.
violations.corrective_action: Please obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program before a follow-up inspection. The follow-up inspection will be conducted within 10 days.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the health department permit to operate in a conspicuous location.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue. The EHS informed the manager that the permit must be posted. He stated he is working with the landlord on where he is allowed to post it. The manager will leave it on the counter until then. Correct as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection. BUFFALO WILD WINGS GO (Inspection Date: 09/02/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. There was no certified food manager present when the inspection started.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. The CFM listed on this report arrived before the inspection ended.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink. THERE WAS NO HANDSOAP AVAILABLE AT THE FRONT HANDSINK.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. THE MANAGER INSTALLED HANDSOAP DURING THE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees. THE SIGN WAS MISSING ON THE TWO HANDSINKS IN THE BACK OF THE ESTABLISHMENT.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. INSTALL THE NECESSARY SIGNS AS SOON AS POSSIBLE OR BEFORE THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter. There was a wet wiping cloth stored on the handsink next to the hot holding cabinet.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. The manager moved the wiping cloth to a sanitizer bucket.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed an unapproved backflow prevention device (splitter) on the mop sink.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. Remove the installed splitter to correct this and install a Hydro Systems 1951 Pressure Bleed Dual Valve device. The EHS provided the device information to the manager and he ordered it during the inspection.

out_items.name: Garbage and refuse properly disposed, facilities maintained

violations.title: Outside Receptacle, Tight Fitting Lids
violations.observation: Outside refuse container was uncovered. The food waste dumpster and recycling dumpster lids and doors were both opened.
violations.corrective_action: Receptacles and waste handling units for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be kept covered with tight fitting lids or doors if kept outside the food establishment. This was corrected during the inspection by closing the lids and doors.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed gaps in the ceiling panels over the water heater and the oil management system which need to be repaired and sealed to prevent vermin entry.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. Seal the gaps and holes as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection.
